title: Finite-Memory Prediction and Remote Feedback in Langton’s Ant
description: Total fixed-D old-black event prediction, exact full-history XOR continuation, quadratic finite-event budgets, endpoint tubes, fixed-region event filtering, remote long-lived feedback necessity, and the twenty-black spatial-scale obstruction. Birth-filtered total queries return the first newly generated remote old lifetime and its complete endpoint; growing-scale necessity gives Omega(sqrt(H)/log(H)) late-born lifetimes with increasing radius and age on non-eventually-translating orbits.
